title: Phasic/tonic EDA decomposition reproduces NeuroKit2 on real data

dataset.name: PhysioNet Non-EEG Dataset for Assessment of Neurological Status
dataset.citation: Birjandtalab J, et al. A Non-EEG Dataset for Assessment of Neurological Status. 2016. Goldberger AL, et al. PhysioNet. Circulation. 2000;101(23):e215-20.

proposition: When the decomposition algorithm is truly matched, PhysioEDA reproduces the gold-standard NeuroKit2 phasic/tonic split on real electrodermal activity: highpass phasic r = 0.957 and tonic r = 0.999.

validation.data: REAL — PhysioNet Non-EEG dataset EDA channel
validation.note: Method-matched comparison (same real signal, same highpass method on both sides).

open_questions.q: Under cvxEDA both tools return a smooth phasic component and agree less (phasic r = 0.65) — a definitional match on the smooth signal, not a defect; an earlier report that misread this as a divergence was corrected. Documented and resolved; the case reports the truly-matched highpass comparison.
